title: The Storage Room Murder
motive_summary: Beatrice Lowell owed Silas Thorne a massive debt and could not pay before the deadline.
overview_text: 11:08 — Silas Thorne found dead in Priya's Flat by Claudia Jensen. Several villagers passed nearby around that time; no one claims to have seen what happened. The morning can be rewound from 08:56.
